title: Cloud Aggregation
desc: 6 providers, multiple accounts each, one combined Files view or each cloud's own native folder tree.

title: Sync Pairs
desc: Two-way, backup-only, or download-only sync between a local folder and a cloud account or a paired device.

title: Universal Sync Folder
desc: One cloud login, one host folder, broadcast to every device you grant it to at once.

title: Nearby Share
desc: Send a file to any AllieMinate device on the same network, paired or not, with a real accept/decline prompt.

title: Universal Clipboard
desc: Copy on a desktop, paste on another paired desktop or an Android phone — desktop → phone/desktop only.

title: Device Pairing
desc: Pair over Wi-Fi (QR code) or USB. Self-healing across network changes, including a phone's own hotspot.

title: Remote File Browser
desc: Add, delete, move, and share files inside a paired Master's own Sync Pair contents — not just read-only browsing.

title: Cross-Device Search
desc: One query, every connected cloud account, every paired device, at once.

title: Google Photos Integration
desc: Browse and pick from your linked Google Photos library alongside your Drive files.

title: Transfer History
desc: A real, two-directional log of what was sent to a device and what was pulled from one.

title: App Lock & Destructive-Action Auth
desc: Touch ID/PIN on desktop, biometric/device-credential on Android — required again for actions like deleting a Sync Pair.

title: Menu Bar / Tray Quick Access
desc: Recent cloud and device files, thumbnails, inline preview, drag-out, drop-to-send — without opening the full app.
